text:
Ivy R: Quick flag - too many postmortem actions are missing clear owners or verifiers. Thinking a lightweight ritual to keep these moving: weekly 15m 'PM follow-ups', IC on duty runs it, focus only on open items (owner, ETA, blocker, verifier).

Cal N: +1. Recommend adding categories (code/process/infra) in the tracker so monthly trends can show what's systemic.

Zoe P: Can we require a verifier field before closing? Also incidents-bot should DM owners 48h before due date to reduce drift.

Ivy R: Agreed to both. Proposal: tracker columns -> owner, verifier, due_date, category, blocker_tag. Bot DM 48h and 2d overdue, and a 90d stale flag that pings eng leads (no auto-close).

Cal N: For rotation - IC facilitation is perfect. Make a 1-paragraph checklist for ICs so it's low friction (I'll draft).

Zoe P: Weekly notes format request: `item_id - owner (ETA) - short blocker - verifier`. Keeps meeting snappy.

Ivy R: Actions: 1) Cal -> IC checklist + meeting agenda template (due Thu). 2) Ivy -> add verifier+category to tracker and wire bot reminders (due Fri). 3) Zoe -> test DM flow on staging (due Mon).

incidents-bot: Reminder created: weekly 'PM follow-ups' Mon 09:15-09:30. New tracker columns added: verifier, category, due_date_reminder.

Ivy R: If no objections I'll schedule the meeting and post templates.

Zoe P: :+1: Thanks.

Cal N: Will upload checklist link here when done.
